title: Copilot Prompt Submitted Event
description: Emitted when a user prompt is submitted to GitHub Copilot CLI. Producer is bloodbank/services/agent-hooks/copilot/publish.py invoked via the userPromptSubmitted hook. The data.payload field is a passthrough of the Copilot-supplied hook JSON; treat as opaque.

type.description: Locked event type for this schema.

hook.description: Locked Copilot hook name for this schema.

payload.description: Raw stdin JSON the Copilot CLI supplied to the hook. Schema is owned by Copilot upstream and is intentionally not constrained here.
